items.title: This is placeholder content
items.excerpt: Run the fetch script (or let the GitHub Action run on its schedule) to replace this with real posts from the feeds you configure in feeds.json.

items.title: Cards with an image look like this
items.excerpt: When a feed item has an image, it fills the card as a full-bleed background with the text overlaid at the bottom.

items.title: Swipe or scroll to move through the feed
items.excerpt: The little dots on the right edge track your position in the stack, like a bookmark ribbon.
